resource.title: Hugging Face Audio Course（官方免费教程站）
resource.covers: 官方 8 个单元的免费教程，浏览器里边读边跑代码：Unit 1 音频数据与表征（采样、波形、频谱图/特征、数据准备与切分）、Unit 2 音频任务总览（音频分类、语音识别、语音合成、语音翻译）、Unit 3 用于音频的 Transformer 架构（Wav2Vec2、Whisper、CTC）、Unit 4 训练音乐流派分类器、Unit 5 自动语音识别（用预训练模型转写、WER 等评测指标、微调 Whisper）、Unit 6 文本转语音（SpeechT5、微调与声码器）、Unit 7 综合项目（语音到语音翻译）、Unit 8 收尾。对应节点的音频表征、声学建模（Transformer/CTC）、语音识别、语音合成与语音交互应用。

courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: Proficiency in Python. Homework assignments will be in a mixture of Python using PyTorch, Jupyter Notebooks, Amazon Skills Kit, and other tools. ... Foundations of Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (CS 124, CS 129, CS 221, CS 224N, CS 229 or equivalent). You should be comfortable with basic concepts of machine learning and natural language processing. We do not strictly enforce a particular set of previous courses but students will have to fill in gaps on their own depending on background.

Pre-requisites: (none listed) ... Other requirements: The course content involves some mathematical concepts and the course work will involve some coding (e.g. Python and Unix shell scripting). Though we will primarily take a conceptual approach, some background in basic linear algebra and probability will be beneficial, as will some experience in using the Unix command line.

extra_prereqs.evidence: Stanford CS224S 第一条先修 'Proficiency in Python'（作业用 PyTorch/Jupyter）；Edinburgh LASC11158 'course work will involve some coding (e.g. Python and Unix shell scripting)'。

CS224S 要求 'Foundations of Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (CS 124, CS 129, CS 221, CS 224N, CS 229 or equivalent)'，并说 'You should be comfortable with basic concepts of machine learning and natural language processing'。
Edinburgh LASC11158：'some background in basic linear algebra and probability will be beneficial'。
同上（'basic linear algebra and probability'）。

notes: H.1.3 记 not_mentioned：两门课都没把信号与系统/数字信号处理列为先修。Edinburgh LASC11158 把 DSP 内容当作课内知识直接讲（原文列出的课程要点包含 'the Discrete Fourier Transform and frequency spectrums, the source-filter model of speech'），Stanford CS224S 则完全走深度学习+对话系统路线（作业是转写、合成、微调 ASR 模型）。也就是说「语音与音频智能」这条线上，原图把 H.1.3 当前置更像工程传统（信号处理系）的路线，DL 系课程不这么要求。资源选 Hugging Face Audio Course 而不是 SLP3 第 15-17 章或 CS224S：这是官方维护、免费、能在浏览器里边练边学的教程，覆盖音频表征→ASR→TTS→语音翻译的完整落地链路；但它自己写明面向 'learners with a background in deep learning, and general familiarity with transformers'，所以需要先有 A.2.3。若要看声学建模的理论（HMM、GMM-HMM、CTC 推导），补充 SLP3 第 15-17 章（https://web.stanford.edu/~jurafsky/slp3/ ，已核实同一站点）或 CS224S 的公开 slides。
